name: ruin-and-redeem
title: Ruin and Redeem
description: A divine court where players act as minor deities trying to 'fix' or 'ruin' mortal situations.
instructions: Ruin a blessing, then redeem someone else's ruin. Vote on the best redemption!

amen.title: Grace & Mischief
amen.description: Play as angels and imps — help or hinder mortals in funny scenarios. The congregation judges!
